verdicts.title: Form factors for $B$ to $Kll$ semileptonic decay from three-flavor lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the $B \to Kl^+l^-$ semileptonic decay process in three-flavor lattice QCD. We analyze several ensembles generated by the MILC collaboration at different lattice spacings and sea-quark masses. verdicts.title: The Dyson-Schwinger equation of a link variable in lattice Landau gauge theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We derive the Dyson-Schwinger equation of a link variable in SU(n) lattice gauge theory in minimal Landau gauge and confront it with Monte-Carlo data for the different terms. Preliminary results for the lattice analog of the Kugo-Ojima confinement criterion is also shown.
